Eligibility

Profile Type:
Working Professionals

Who Should Apply?

If you're the kind of engineer who experiments with AI, enjoys understanding how systems work, and is energised by solving difficult problems, you'll fit right in.

Whether you're creating AI applications, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or enterprise software, Tech Catalyst is designed for people who are constantly learning, experimenting, and shipping.

If you're looking to test your skills alongside some of the country's strongest technical talent while working on challenges from Bessemer's portfolio companies, we'd love to see you in Bengaluru.

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience working with tech & product companies.
  • Location: Bengaluru (While the hackathon is in Bengaluru, companies are looking at hiring in Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Chennai, Mumbai, Remote).
  • A strong interest in deploying AI powered products and solutions.
  • Ex-Founder: If you have built your own tech/ product startup.
  • Software Engineers who have been working with tech & product companies: AI Lead, DevOps Engineer, AWS Cloud/ Infra, AI / Voice & Agentic, AI/ML Engineer, Data Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer- AI/ML, Full Stack Engineer & many more.

Rules

1. Original Work

  • All solutions must be original and created specifically for this hackathon.
  • Plagiarism or the use of pre-existing solutions is strictly prohibited.

2. Code of Conduct

  • Maintain professionalism and respect towards all participants, mentors, and organisers.
  • Any form of harassment or discrimination will not be tolerated.

3. Technical Requirements

  • Ensure you have the necessary hardware, software, and internet access to participate effectively.
  • The hackathon will provide the necessary resources and support.

4. Assessment

  • Complete your assessment within the specified deadline on August 8th.
  • Late submissions will not be accepted.
